post-summary: September 1, 2026 · A bathroom tile job in Seattle runs $14-$26 per square foot installed, and the spread between quotes is almost never the tile. It is the substrate prep and the waterproofing behind the shower. Here is where the money actually goes, and the three questions that separate a number you can trust from one designed to win the job.
